subject: Renewal: staggered invoice runs, PO lock, and W9 follow-up
messages:
From: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@nebulasoft.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procure@nebulasoft.com
Date: 2027-06-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: scheduling invoices and PO coordination

Hi Grace / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has approved the renewal and the upgraded capacity add-on, but we need to confirm invoicing cadence. Our finance team can only process 2 invoice runs this quarter: one at renewal effective date (7/1) and a second on 9/1. Can you confirm Redwood can split the committed amount across those two invoices and attach the PO to each?

Also attached is our PO (NebulaSoft_PO_4231.pdf). We will send an updated W9 once our legal entity name finalizes later this week — can Redwood accept a temporary PO match and then replace W9 within 7 business days?

Thanks,
Clara Diaz
Director, Procurement
NebulaSoft

Attachments: NebulaSoft_PO_4231.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@nebulasoft.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: scheduling invoices and PO coordination

Clara — really glad to hear procurement is aligned. Short answers below: 

- Yes, we can schedule two invoices to match 7/1 and 9/1. I will request billing to create a split invoice plan and associate the PO to both runs.
- We can temporarily accept the PO now and proceed on 7/1 provided the updated W9 arrives within 7 business days of the first invoice. Our finance policy allows provisional PO binding in this scenario.

Grace / Marissa: can you confirm the account code and whether we need a manual invoice split in the billing portal or if it can be automated? If manual, I'll ask Procurement to confirm net terms per invoice.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Note: attaching the PO to both invoice runs is preferred for their AR workflow.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@nebulasoft.com>, procure@nebulasoft.com
Date: 2027-06-21T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: scheduling invoices and PO coordination

Folks — billing ops here. Quick ops notes and a checklist: 

1) We can do a staggered invoice schedule (one invoice dated 2027-07-01, second dated 2027-09-01). I will create two invoice templates and link NebulaSoft_PO_4231.pdf to both.
2) Net terms: default net30 will apply unless Procurement confirms net45 or net60. Clara, please confirm if both invoices should be net30 or if the second should carry a different term.
3) W9: we can process the first invoice with the PO on provisional basis but will hold payment until W9 is received. We will set a 7-business-day window from 7/2 for W9 submission; if not received finance will flag the account for hold and notify AP.
4) Account code: use BU-Cloud-Inference / revenue line 4002. Jonas, please confirm mapping into the committed SKU hierarchy so revenue recognizes correctly across the two invoices.

I attached an invoice schedule spreadsheet (Renewal_renewal_schedule.xlsx) with the split calculations and placeholders for PO and W9 dates.

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Renewal_renewal_schedule.xlsx

From: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@nebulasoft.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: procure@nebulasoft.com, Ethan Park (AP) <ethan.park@nebulasoft.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: scheduling invoices and PO coordination

Thanks all — confirming:

- We accept two invoice runs on 2027-07-01 and 2027-09-01.
- Both invoices should be net30.
- AP (Ethan) will upload updated W9 to you by 2027-07-06 (attached placeholder: NebulaSoft_W9_v2.pdf).
- Please proceed to attach the PO to both invoices and create the split schedule. If billing needs a DocuSign or any additional form, flag it here.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Clara
